words.definition: a machine that you use to talk to someone who is in another place
words.example: I call my mother on my phone every evening.

words.definition: a machine that stores and uses information
words.example: I write my homework on my computer.

words.definition: a large system of connected computers that lets people share information
words.example: We use the internet to find information.

words.definition: to talk to someone by phone
words.example: Please call me when you arrive.

words.definition: a short piece of writing or speech that you send to someone
words.example: She sent me a message this morning.

words.definition: the flat part of a phone or computer where you see pictures and words
words.example: The screen on my phone is very big.

words.definition: a small part that you push to make a machine work
words.example: Press this button to turn on the light.

words.definition: to put electricity into a phone or battery
words.example: I charge my phone every night.

words.definition: a small object that gives power to a machine
words.example: My phone's battery is low.

words.definition: a picture made with a camera
words.example: I took a photo of my dog.

words.definition: a film that you watch on a screen
words.example: We watched a funny video together.

words.definition: to make something go to another place
words.example: Can you send me the photo, please?

words.definition: to press a button on a computer with a mouse or finger
words.example: Click here to open the app.

words.definition: to copy something from the internet to your phone or computer
words.example: I want to download a new app.

words.definition: a small computer program on a phone
words.example: This app helps me learn English.

words.definition: a secret word that you use to open your phone or account
words.example: I forgot my password again.

words.definition: a message that you send using a computer or phone
words.example: I check my email every morning.

words.definition: to make a machine start working
words.example: Please turn on the computer for me.

words.definition: not working; damaged
words.example: My brother's phone is broken.

words.definition: not old; made or bought recently
words.example: She bought a new computer last week.

text: Every day, I use my phone. My phone is not new, but it is not broken. In the morning, I turn on my computer and check my email. I have many apps on my phone. One app helps me send messages to my friends. I often call my mother in the evening. We talk about our day. My phone has a big screen, so I can watch a video easily. Yesterday, I took a photo of my dog and sent it to my sister. She liked the photo very much. Sometimes I click on a button to download a new app. But first, I need a password to open the app store. My phone's battery is often low, so I charge it every night. Without the internet, I cannot send messages or watch videos. My brother's phone is broken, so he wants to buy a new one. Technology helps us talk to people far away. I think phones and computers are very useful in our life today.
